hypothesis: Can a tokenless eight-cell native causal learner detect that its 36-feature quadratic substrate cannot represent genuine observed action consequences, structurally grow to a 92-feature cubic substrate, repair knowledge from a bounded original public-experience buffer, and cold-transfer the inferred rule to unfamiliar actuator combinations? Compare with independent conventional 92-feature exact solver and identical evidence-triggered conventional growth; do not call a tie a uniquely better architecture.

source.physical_actuator_steps: Five real source actions [3,0,1,2,3], neutral action identifies 1..3 rotation, action0 public reveals A, action1 reveals B, action2 schedules one-step pending A XOR f(B), action3 reveals pending after real transition. Before each actual step every learner sees ONLY current public 8 bits and announced action, then real public afteraction change; private source law, seed, trial, coefficients, pending and oracle future are evaluator-only.
source.initial: first SHA256('ST8-x0|'+seed+'|'+trial+'|'+nonce)[0] nonce from 0..255 for which rotations1,2,3 are pairwise distinguishable; no law or outcome used
source.true_frozen_rule: f(B) is 8-output XOR of 92 independent monomials from B: 8 degree-one terms, 28 unordered degree-two terms, 56 unordered degree-three terms. For each output bit j and feature k, coefficient= SHA256('ST8-cubic|'+j+'|'+k)[0]&1. Globally shared across all same-rule training, held and interference laws. These 736 actual bits are evaluator-private and not hardcoded or enumerated in candidate/control.
source.negative_rule: For distinct negative law IDs [43,47], alternative privately seeded 736-bit coefficient matrix from SHA256('ST8-negative|'+j+'|'+k)[0]&1 plus quartic interaction B0&B1&B2&B3 in output bit0. Models receive no mechanism ID, zero updates on negatives.

candidate.architecture: Native integer 8-cell learned GF2 predictor initialized with 36 linear+quadratic feature rows. Each actual public B/residual y is recorded in a bounded 256-element (B,y) cache, deduplicated, conflict-checked. Fit incremental 36x44 GF2 constraints. On first TRUE contradiction (nonzero residual with zero feature rank), unlock degree-three interactions and replay frozen historical public (B,y) evidence into a 92x100 GF2 incremental constraint matrix. No private source rule/masks and no menu containing correct 736-bit map.
candidate.trigger: Exactly first genuine quadratic inconsistent public action consequence. Expansion happens only after outcome, not before. No tuning/forking after held performance. Predictions for not-yet-representable features always .5; predictions for implied rows use .99/.01. Candidate uses fixed high-bit deterministic elimination, bounded 256 evidence pairs (512 payload bytes), 92 rows of 100 bits; report actual total memory/checkpoint and whole cost.
candidate.memory: 92 rows x100 bits=9200 learned GF2 bits (1150 packed or 1196 at 13 bytes per row); 512 additional unique public cache bytes, 92-feature family is a disclosed upper structural prior. Conventional matched adaptive baseline has the SAME buffer and memory allowance; full cubic comparator has 92x100 learned bits and identical observations, but no buffer needed.

controls: Independent conventional full cubic 92-feature 8-output GF2 solver, trained on ALL identical public actions with 9200-bit learned row evidence, without contradiction/replay overhead.

Independent conventional adaptive 36-to-92 GF2 solver with same post-action contradiction trigger, 256 public-pair replay cache, upper feature prior and exact memory allowance; ties do not count as unique native mechanism.

metrics.primary: Frozen four previously unseen same-cubic-rule law IDs, eight new seeds, 16 trials each: genuine final-action preaction changed-bit Brier <=0.02 pooled and <=0.04 for EACH law; no held fitting.
metrics.mechanism: Candidate must trigger exactly from >=1 authentic training quadratic contradiction, reach cubic rank92 with zero post-expansion conflicts, and show >=0.10 absolute Brier gain over each ST7 quadratic, no-growth, no-replay, erased controls on held unfamiliar worlds; same-information full cubic and conventional adaptive must be qualified fully, candidate non-inferior within 0.01.
metrics.negative: Different private polynomial + quartic negative laws: Brier >=0.10, record result, acknowledge failure to transfer to different family; no negative fitting or after-result tuning.
metrics.retention: Original training law 3, seed 100, trials 16, predict without updating before and after eight same-rule interference laws. >=95% chance-corrected gain retained and <=0.02 absolute Brier deterioration.
metrics.cost_and_custody: One exact shared Linux-trained checkpoint reused as bytes Linux+Windows. All original source SHA, candidate integer cold state, scores identical <=1e-12 cross OS. Total source+actor+full training+evaluation measured wall ratio <=1.5x fastest full cubic/identical adaptive conventional baseline separately on EACH OS. Entire evidence buffer+learned matrix overhead, CPU/wall/shared RSS and source cost recorded. Full G29 final and independent scientific first use separately UNVERIFIED.
metrics.classification: PASS all frozen thresholds => STRUCTURAL_GROWTH_DEV_SIGNAL_NOT_INDEPENDENT_SCIENCE; any frozen fail => DEV_NO_GO. No implication of universal physics discovery, uniquely superior algorithm, general AI or RSI.
